topic: 2025-2026 FEED, environmental approval, and offtake progress toward FID
wiki_text: INPEX (operator, via INPEX Masela Ltd) advanced the Abadi LNG project in the Masela Block through 2025-2026 with partners Pertamina (20%) and Petronas/Petroliam Nasional (15%). Front-end engineering design (FEED) commenced in August 2025, completing all four FEED package awards for the onshore LNG (OLNG) plant. The Indonesian government granted environmental approval in February 2026. In May 2026 INPEX reported preliminary LNG/pipeline-gas offtake agreements in principle with bp, PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (PGN), PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia, and Shell Eastern Trading. A final investment decision is targeted for 2026-2027 (SKK Migas has pressed for 2026), with first production targeted around 2030. The project remained at GEM status 'proposed' (pre-FID) as of this June 2026 sweep.

topic: Operating since Feb 2022; supply chain and 2023 ownership change
wiki_text: The Gorontalo FSRU (relocated from Amurang, North Sulawesi to Pohuwato, Gorontalo) began operating in February 2022, regasifying LNG carried from Bontang to supply the PLTG Maleo/Paguat gas-fired power plant (~100 MW), delivering up to ~24 MMcf/d. The FSRU charter runs to 2035. In July 2023, Energi Mega Persada (EMP, Bakrie Group) was reported to have acquired Sulawesi Regas Satu, the FSRU asset owner, expected to provide fixed income over ~12 years while supporting PLN's electricity supply in Gorontalo. GEM currently lists Owner=PT Sulawesi Satu and Parent=Humpuss/PLN GG with operator PT GTS Internasional; the EMP acquisition and the relationship among these entities should be reconciled in a follow-on Update before changing owner/parent fields.
